title: All (of), whole, every, each
summary: Различия между **all (of)**, **whole**, **every** и **each**: целое или части, единственное или множественное число, место в предложении и устойчивые модели.
ru:
## Целое или каждый по отдельности
Эти слова описывают «всё» с разных сторон. **All** и **whole** смотрят на целое: *all the money, the whole town*. **Every** и **each** разбирают это целое на отдельные части: *every student, each room*. Существительное после **every / each** всегда в единственном числе.
> **All the** students passed. — Все студенты сдали (группой).
> **Every** student passed. — Каждый студент сдал (проверяем по одному).
> **Each** student received a certificate. — Каждый студент получил свой сертификат.

## all и all of
Перед существительным с **the / my / these** слово **of** необязательно: *all (of) the guests, all (of) my friends.* Перед **местоимением** **of** обязателен: *all of us, all of them, all of it* (~~all us~~). Без артикля и притяжательного слова — только **all**: *all children, all information*. С временными словами **the** часто не нужно: **all day, all night, all week, all year**.
> We worked **all night**. = We worked **the whole night**. — Мы работали всю ночь.

## whole
**Whole** — «целый, весь, нетронутый». Ставится **после** артикля или притяжательного слова и обычно с **единственным числом счётного** существительного: *the whole town, a whole week, my whole life*. Нельзя: ~~whole the town~~, ~~the whole money~~ (с неисчисляемыми берём **all the money**). Перед названиями мест и абстракциями используют **the whole of**: *the whole of Europe, the whole of the afternoon.* Разговорные модели: **a whole lot of** (очень много), **a whole new approach** (совершенно новый подход).

## every и каждый-по-отдельности
**Every** обычно подразумевает три и более, а также повторяемость во времени: *every day, every other week* (через неделю), *every three hours*. С **almost, nearly, practically** допустим **every**, но не **each**: *almost every shop.* Не путайте: **everyone** (= все люди, одно слово) и **every one** (каждый из...): *Everyone came. Every one of them was late.*
- ~~Every of the students~~ → **Every one** of the students / **Each** of the students

## each
**Each** можно использовать и для двух предметов, и для большего числа; подчёркивает индивидуальность. Конструкции: **each + сущ.**, **each of + мн. число с определителем**, **each** после подлежащего или в конце фразы.
> **Each of the** rooms **has** its own bathroom. — В каждой из комнат есть своя ванная.
> The tickets cost £20 **each**. — Билеты стоят по 20 фунтов.
> The two sisters **each** have a car. — У каждой из двух сестёр есть машина.

## Согласование и порядок слов
После **each of / every one of** формальный глагол — **единственное** число (*has*), в речи часто звучит и множественное. **All** может стоять в «середине» предложения: *We **all** agree. They have **all** gone. They are **all** ready.*
- ~~We were late all.~~ → We were **all** late.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~The whole money was stolen.~~ → **All the money** was stolen.
- ~~Every students~~ → **Every student**
- ~~I've seen almost each film.~~ → I've seen almost **every** film.
en:
## The whole, or one by one
These words describe 'everything' from different angles. **All** and **whole** look at the entire group or thing: *all the money, the whole town*. **Every** and **each** split it into individual parts: *every student, each room*. After **every / each** the noun is always singular.
> **All the** students passed. (as a group)
> **Every** student passed. (checking one by one)
> **Each** student received a certificate. (a separate certificate for each)

## all and all of
Before a noun with **the / my / these**, **of** is optional: *all (of) the guests, all (of) my friends.* Before a **pronoun**, **of** is required: *all of us, all of them, all of it* (~~all us~~). With no determiner, use **all** only: *all children, all information*. With time words we often drop **the**: **all day, all night, all week, all year**.
> We worked **all night**. = We worked **the whole night**.

## whole
**Whole** means 'complete, entire'. It goes **after** the article or possessive and usually with a **singular countable** noun: *the whole town, a whole week, my whole life*. Not ~~whole the town~~, and not ~~the whole money~~ (for uncountables use **all the money**). Before places and abstract ideas we also use **the whole of**: *the whole of Europe*. Informal: **a whole lot of** (very many), **a whole new approach**.

## every
**Every** normally implies three or more, and repetition in time: *every day, every other week* (alternate weeks), *every three hours*. With **almost, nearly, practically** we can use **every**, not **each**: *almost every shop.* Compare **everyone** (all people, one word) and **every one** (each of them): *Everyone came. Every one of them was late.*
- ~~Every of the students~~ → **Every one** of the students / **Each** of the students

## each
**Each** works for two things or more and stresses individuality. Patterns: **each + noun**, **each of + plural with a determiner**, and **each** after the subject or at the end.
> **Each of the** rooms **has** its own bathroom.
> The tickets cost £20 **each**.
> The two sisters **each** have a car.

## Agreement and word order
After **each of / every one of** the formal verb is **singular** (*has*), though plural is common in speech. **All** can go in the middle of a sentence: *We **all** agree. They have **all** gone. They are **all** ready.*
- ~~We were late all.~~ → We were **all** late.

## Common mistakes
- ~~The whole money was stolen.~~ → **All the money** was stolen.
- ~~Every students~~ → **Every student**
- ~~I've seen almost each film.~~ → I've seen almost **every** film.
structure:
## Сравнительная таблица
| Слово | Значение | За ним | Пример |
|---|---|---|---|
| **all (of)** | всё целое / все вместе | мн. число или неисчисл. | **All (of) the** staff left. |
| **whole** | целый, весь | ед. число счётное, после the/a/my | **The whole** office was empty. |
| **every** | каждый (из 3+), повтор | ед. число | **Every** employee has a badge. |
| **each** | каждый по отдельности (2+) | ед. число / of + мн. | **Each** of them has a badge. |
| **every one of / each of** | каждый из группы | мн. с определителем | **Every one of them** left. |

## Формулы
> **all** (of) + the / my / these + сущ. · **all of** + us / you / them / it
> the / a / my + **whole** + ед. число · **the whole of** + место / абстракция
> **every / each** + ед. сущ. + глагол в ед. числе
> **each of** + the / my / them + глагол (в ед. числе)

## Положение в предложении
| Подлежащее + be | Подлежащее + глагол | В конце |
|---|---|---|
| They are **all** ready. | They **all** agree. | The tickets cost £5 **each**. |
| We were **each** given a prize. | They have **all** gone. | We got a prize **each**. |

exercises.title: all, whole, every, each
exercises.example: I waited ___ morning. → I waited **all** morning.

items.text: I've been waiting here {{all|the whole}} morning.
{{Every|Each}} one of the candidates was interviewed twice.
{{All of}} us were exhausted after the journey.
{{Every}} three months the committee reviews the budget.
The two sisters {{each}} have their own room.

exercises.title: Вставьте нужное слово
exercises.instruction: Вставьте одно слово (**all, whole, one, other, everyone** и т.д.).

items.text: {{Everyone|Everybody}} has to bring their own laptop.
Every {{one}} of the vases was cracked.
The children have {{all}} gone to bed.
Not {{all}} the delegates agreed with the proposal.

items.q: ___ the guests were seated when the speeches began.
items.why: Перед **the guests** (мн. число) — **all**; **every / each** требуют единственного числа без **the**.

items.q: She has read ___ the books on the list.
items.why: **All the books** — все книги; **whole** ставится после артикля.
После **the** — **whole** + ед. число. **All** стоит перед артиклем: **all the weekend**.

items.q: ___ student in the class has to give a presentation.
___ of us has a different opinion.
items.why: Глагол **has** в единственном числе → **Each of us**.

items.q: The ___ of the village was flooded.
items.why: **The whole of + место / целое**; **all** не стоит после **the**.

options: The whole of money was stolen.
items.why: Money неисчисляемое: **all the money**; **whole** и **every** нужны со счётными.

options: Every one of the students passed.
All one of the students passed.
I've seen almost each film he made.
I've seen almost every film he made.
I've seen almost all film he made.
Each of the two flat has a balcony.
Each of the two flats has a balcony.
Every of the two flats has a balcony.
items.why: **Each of** + существительное во мн. числе с определителем (**the two flats**), глагол — в единственном числе; **every of** не бывает.

items.q: Что значит She comes here every other week?
items.why: **Every other** = через один: «раз в две недели».

items.q: Какой вариант значит «Все в сборе, можно начинать»?
options: Everyone's here, so we can begin.
Every one's here, so we can begin.
Each one here, so we can begin.
items.why: **Everyone** (одно слово) = все люди; **every one** значит «каждый из (предметов / группы)» и требует уточнения, о ком или о чём речь.

exercises.title: Перепишите с указанным словом
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, используя то, что в скобках.

items.prompt: (Use whole) We spent all the morning in the queue.
answers: We spent the whole morning in the queue.

items.prompt: (Use all) She worked the whole night.
(Use each of) Every one of the players received a medal.
answers: Each of the players received a medal.

items.prompt: (Use every) Each person in the building must sign in.
answers: Every person in the building must sign in.

items.prompt: (Use each, at the end) The tickets cost £20 per person.
(Use the whole of) All the country was without electricity.
answers: The whole of the country was without electricity.
The whole country was without electricity.

exercises.title: Трансформации
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, используя то, что в скобках.

items.prompt: (Use every other) She visits her parents once every two weeks.
answers: She visits her parents every other week.

items.prompt: (Use almost every) Nearly all the shops on the street were closed.
answers: Almost every shop on the street was closed.

items.prompt: (Use each other) Anna phoned Peter, and Peter phoned Anna.
answers: Anna and Peter phoned each other.
Peter and Anna phoned each other.

items.prompt: (Start with Everyone) All of the people at the party enjoyed themselves.
answers: Everyone at the party enjoyed themselves.
Everybody at the party enjoyed themselves.

items.prompt: (Use all, in the middle) We are ready, every one of us.
(Use the whole) I read the entire novel in one night.
answers: I read the whole novel in one night.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями, используя **all, whole, every** или **each**.

items.prompt: What do you do every day without fail?
items.sample: I check my email every day before breakfast.

items.prompt: Describe a time you spent the whole day doing one thing.
items.sample: Last Sunday I spent the whole day repairing my bicycle.

items.prompt: Write about your family. Use each of or all of.
items.sample: Each of my brothers lives in a different city, but all of us meet at New Year.

items.prompt: What do you do every other week or every other day?
items.sample: I go swimming every other day.

items.prompt: Describe a group you belong to. Use we all.
items.sample: In my team we all enjoy long meetings, which is rare.

items.prompt: Name something you've never done in your whole life.
items.sample: I've never been abroad in my whole life.
